title: subscribe
description: Client to resident: from now on, send the events these patterns name. Replaces the connection's subscription; an empty list ends it. The resident answers subscribed, or unknown_event with the same id.

id.description: Chosen by the client, 1 to 128 bytes; the reply carries it back. Distinct among the connection's requests in flight.

events.description: Event names or globs, * the only wildcard (core:*, core:hints.*); each must name at least one streamed event.
